root_cause: The prior “Paper database is unavailable” state was environmental: no PostgreSQL listener on 5432, readiness returned 503, and the existing Python venv lacked psycopg. Docker Desktop was available in the resumed environment but its CLI directory was not on the initial PATH. Adding it to process-local PATH and installing only psycopg[binary]==3.2.1 into the existing venv enabled the existing Compose database integration; live catalog, classification, and retrieval paths then passed. No backend query or label-mapping defect was reproduced.
targeted_corrections: Compose publishes PostgreSQL on host loopback only.
Set frontend container HOSTNAME to 0.0.0.0 for its Compose healthcheck.
Frontend image uses npm ci --include=dev with the existing pinned lockfile.
